ablations.note: NEUTRAL: +1 top-1 case, but -4 points MS/MS coverage and +1 false ID versus S0; the scorer is not the source of any v3 gain
REJECTED: train-split kNN templates are optimistic for train compounds; the model does not transfer to held-out scaffolds (see training_report.md)
formula-level loss plausibility can only penalise different-formula distractors; it cannot separate same-formula isomers

open_world.claim: A hard-unknown episode removes the truth and its aliases but keeps precursor-consistent distractors. The relative softmax support is useless here (it always sums to one); the absolute fit of the best candidate is the usable signal. The score and its threshold are chosen on the development split and applied unchanged to test.
